hypothesis: Several latest projected population-growth rates are below zero.
evidence_summary: 8 of 22 geographies have a negative latest published projection/estimated population-growth rate in 2025.
named_geographies: American Samoa (AS); Cook Islands (CK); Marshall Islands (MH); Northern Mariana Islands (MP); Palau (PW); Tonga (TO); Tuvalu (TV); Wallis and Futuna Islands (WF)
decision: Keep as projected demographic context; do not treat it as observed change or size.
caveat: Published projection/estimated rate; not observed population change, population size, or climate vulnerability.

hypothesis: Essential-service and energy-transition measures do not move as one progress axis.
evidence_summary: Papua New Guinea water changed +18.49 points while renewable share changed -15.60; Samoa changed +11.98 and -27.94, respectively.
time_basis: first-to-latest percentage-point changes within each indicator
decision: Audition a cross-current story while keeping the two measures on separate axes.
caveat: The movements are descriptive and are not attributed to climate or policy causes.

hypothesis: Latest safely managed drinking-water shares remain uneven.
named_geographies: Papua New Guinea (PG); Solomon Islands (SB); Wallis and Futuna Islands (WF); Tuvalu (TV)
time_basis: latest returned value per geography; latest years span 2020-2022
decision: Use named-place contrasts with visible years, not a synchronized league table.
caveat: This is essential-service context, not a climate-attribution measure.

hypothesis: Recorded disaster loss is evidence of reporting visibility, not a complete trend.
evidence_summary: The source returns 39 records across 12 geographies and 2007-2020 (39/168 possible geography-years).
named_geographies: Fiji (FJ); Micronesia (Federated States of) (FM); Kiribati (KI); Marshall Islands (MH); New Caledonia (NC); French Polynesia (PF); Papua New Guinea (PG); Palau (PW); Solomon Islands (SB); Tonga (TO); Vanuatu (VU); Samoa (WS)
time_basis: recorded event-years; USD_MILLIONS converted to USD
decision: Show a reporting raster and recorded events; reject a continuous loss trend.
caveat: Unreported years are missing records, not zero-loss years.

hypothesis: The land-cover index varies sharply, but its direction cannot yet carry a public claim.
evidence_summary: Latest 2022 values range from 51.4 in Samoa to 133.3 in Solomon Islands.
time_basis: published index trajectories and latest 2022 values
decision: Keep in the research atlas; do not label high/low as better/worse.
caveat: The source direction and baseline need review before narrative interpretation.

hypothesis: The candidates form one coherent progress ladder.
evidence_summary: Latest water and renewable within-indicator ranks correlate -0.43; named trajectories also move in opposing directions.
named_geographies: Papua New Guinea (PG); Samoa (WS); Tuvalu (TV); Solomon Islands (SB)
time_basis: within-indicator latest ranks; no raw cross-unit arithmetic
decision: Reject a new candidate composite and retain a profile/contrast form.
caveat: Rank correlation is descriptive and latest years are not perfectly aligned.

hypothesis: Recorded disaster loss can be compared per person.
evidence_summary: The processed candidate set contains a population-growth rate, not population-size denominators.
decision: Do not calculate loss per capita from the available candidate fields.
caveat: A defensible population-size series would be required.

hypothesis: Changes in services, energy, population, or land cover are caused by climate change.
evidence_summary: The official rows are descriptive indicators with no causal identification design.
decision: Use the candidates as conditions and responses, not causal proof.
caveat: Attribution would require external design, controls, and domain evidence.
